name: denodo
description: Create Denodo 9.5 objects from plain-language intent — databases, folders, tags, JDBC/DF/JSON data sources and wrappers, base, derived, interface and metric views, associations, and Data Marketplace tags, categories and external elements — and do the work around them: stored procedures, the full cache of a view, the metadata AI consumers read, roles and global security policies, the server's LLM and embedding model in a query, rows changed through a view after your yes, query results stored as tables, regression tests run by the Denodo Testing Tool, and Denodo Scheduler jobs.
